counterexample.input: Existing Windows junction output directory or junction ancestor pointing to an owned external destination, absent .attackmap-output marker, ordinary atomic request
counterexample.reason: safe_fs.ensure_output_dir217-224 checks is_symlink but not Windows reparse attributes/tags. safe_write_text245-250 resolves marker parent and output to the same redirected target, so relative containment succeeds. Marker creation therefore precedes artifact_publisher.generation_dir52 strict refusal.
counterexample.effect: Marker or missing directories may be created through the junction before later rejection; previous current pointer need not change for this side effect to violate refusal-before-write.

minimal_solution_proposal.policy: Use the existing publisher strict lexical root-to-leaf lstat/reparse policy before any atomic output creation/marking; preserve the existing non-atomic policy separately.
minimal_solution_proposal.shared_api: Small artifact_publisher preparation API wrapping _safe(Path(base)) then ensure_output_dir(base, mark=True); ordinary atomic service and pipeline call this instead of preliminary safe_fs ensure. No duplicate junction implementation.
minimal_solution_proposal.compatibility: Preserve typed ScanRequestError mapping at service boundary and existing non-atomic behavior. Generation and diagnostic APIs retain existing strict checks. Avoid generation allocation or extra diagnostics solely to validate output.
